brain.commentary: Risk-on cross-asset backdrop is offset by mostly flat or negative core-asset signals and modest conviction. The repeated long verdicts for XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are highly fragile: identical conviction/composite values, zero volatility, zero expected shortfall, and no liquidity or institutional inputs indicate likely missing or unreliable data rather than robust alpha. Keep exposure materially scaled down and avoid treating those long signals as confirmed.
